name: Brainattic
tagline: Governed, persistent knowledge for AI coding agents
description: Brainattic is an EU-hosted knowledge base that connects AI agents to trusted organizational knowledge through MCP. It supports hybrid semantic and keyword search, document retrieval, versioned documentation, and permission-controlled creation and editing. Users sign in with their Brainattic account through OAuth 2.1 (PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration). No local server installation or API key is needed.
